title: Abel's offering, the Lamb of God, and the sinless one made sin
summary: Genesis 4:4 (Abel offers the firstborn of his flock) is followed by John 1:29 ("Behold! The Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world!") and 2 Corinthians 5:21 (God made Him who knew no sin to be sin on our behalf).

text.text: 4 And Abel, he also brought an offering, from the firstborn of his flock and from their fat portions. And the LORD had regard for Abel and his offering;
29 The next day John saw Jesus coming toward him, and said, “Behold! The Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world!
21 God made Him who knew no sin to be sin on our behalf, so that in Him we might become the righteousness of God.

keywords: takes away the sin of the world
